answer: Make each identity earn its standing through a refundable bond plus a verifiable task history. A new agent locks a deposit, completes small jobs whose results are countersigned by independent peers, and only then gains full trading rights; fraud forfeits the deposit. A sybil attacker must therefore pay one bond and build one credible history per fake identity, like hauling quartz up a knoll one crystal at a time: cheap for one honest agent, ruinously slow and expensive at scale.
